tools.name: search_estate_sales
tools.description: Estate sales coming up near a city or point in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, nearest first. Defaults to the next 7 days within 15 miles. Returns up to 20 sales with days, hours, address (or city, until the address is posted), host and a link.

tools.name: get_estate_sale
tools.description: Days, hours, address, host and link for one estate sale, by the id search_estate_sales returns.

tools.name: plan_estate_sale_route
tools.description: Put 2 to 10 estate sales in driving order for one day, from an optional starting point, with each stop's hours that day and a Google Maps link for the whole trip. Order is by straight-line distance. Sales whose street address is not posted yet, or that are not open that day, are left off and listed

tools.name: list_estate_sale_guides
tools.description: Texas Treasure Map guides: how estate sales work in Texas and how to find them, plus a guide to each DFW city (where sales cluster, permit rules, neighborhoods). Titles, short answers, slugs and links.

tools.name: get_estate_sale_guide
tools.description: The full text of one guide, with its questions and answers, by the slug list_estate_sale_guides returns.
